segments.text: After I came across this video and watched it, my life completely changed for the better.
Want to read texts, emails, and messages? What they're saying? Even what they delete?
Now you can. No access codes, no sneaky apps, no physical contact with the device.
This tool gives you full live access to their messages and calls, social activity, and much
more. If they've been acting strange, changing their habits, keeping their phone closer than
usual, they're probably not being truthful. It's time to find out what's really going on.
